name: Bee Keeping
benefit:
Under this scheme:

  - Bee families (bees, including the queen bee) and bee colonies (bee boxes) are provided with a 40% subsidy (maximum cost per bee box is ₹2,000/- and per bee colony is ₹2,000/-). 50 bee boxes are provided in plain areas and 25 in hilly areas.
  - For example, if a bee box and bee colony cost ₹200/-, the farmer has to deposit ₹120/- at the concerned Horticulture Mobile team Ce
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer interested in beekeeping.
